newsitem.title: FINLAND: Authorities to probe Pohjola Suomi info.
newsitem.headline: Authorities to probe Pohjola Suomi info.

text.p: The Finnish Financial Supervision authority said on Monday that it would investigate insurer Vakuutustusosakeyhtio Pohjola's information practices surrounding its plan to absorb life insurer Suomi.
"The investigation will be started now ... and a preliminary probe will be done this week," Jarmo Parkkonen, market supervisor at the Financial Supervision, told Reuters by telephone.
The investigation would look into "whether Pohjola's information practices in this (Suomi) matter has been entirely O.K.," Parkkonen said but declined to elaborate.
The investigation will be conducted in cooperation with the Helsinki Stock Exchange, Parkkonen said.
"At this stage, it is difficult to say where it will lead," he said.
The Financial Supervision's probe was partly in response to a request for an investigation from a third party, Parkkonen said.
Asked whether the investigation could prevent or delay Pohjola's plans to take over the insurance portfolio of the Suomi group, Parkkonen said:
"For our part, it could not lead to that," he said.

In January, Pohjola announced a plan to move into the lucrative life-insurance business by shifting the portfolio of associated mutual insurer Suomi into a new life insurer to be founded within the Pohjola group.
